documents.text: ### `http` + Default: `null` An object used to configure the server's listening socket. The options are the same as the Node.js core [`createServer` method](https://nodejs.org/docs/latest-v20.x/api/http.html#httpcreateserveroptions-requestlistener). This option is ignored if options [`http2`](#factory-http2) or [`https`](#factory-https) are set.

### `https` + Default: `null` An object used to configure the server's listening socket for TLS. The options are the same as the Node.js core [`createServer` method](https://nodejs.org/dist/latest-v20.x/docs/api/https.html#https_https_createserver_options_requestlistener). When this property is `null`, the socket will not be configured for TLS. This option also applies when the [`http2`](#factory-http2) option is set.

request.instructions: The documents are sections of the documentation of ONE open-source project at one commit. Report a conflict only when two sections make incompatible statements about the SAME option, flag, default value, limit, version requirement, or behavior, for the same product version and scope. These are NOT conflicts: values of different options; example values in code samples that merely override a default; statements explicitly scoped to an older version or to migration history; one section giving more detail than the other; different defaults that the text ties to different contexts (per-route vs global, dev vs build, agent mode vs server mode).
